info.title: DbEasy CLI
info.description: Command-line interface for DbEasy database migrations and schema management.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display help information.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable detailed diagnostic logging.

options.name: --debug
options.description: Enable technical debugging information.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress non-essential diagnostic logging.

options.name: --log-format
options.description: Select human text or NDJSON structured diagnostics.

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Select human text or one JSON command result on stdout.

options.name: --migration-diagnostics
options.description: Emit migration execution failure diagnostics on stderr.

options.name: --no-migration-diagnostics
options.description:
Disable configured migration execution diagnostics.
--non-interactive Never request user input; fail when required input is missing.

options.name: --environment
options.description:
Select a DbEasy environment profile.
Environment:
DBEASY_NON_INTERACTIVE=true
Enable non-interactive execution for automation.
DBEASY_ENVIRONMENT=Staging
DBEASY_REQUIRE_ENVIRONMENT_IDENTITY=true
Require target database identity verification for target-aware migrations.
DBEASY_LOG_FORMAT=json
Emit structured diagnostic logs as NDJSON on stderr.
DBEASY_OUTPUT_FORMAT=json
Emit one machine-readable command result on stdout.
DBEASY_MIGRATION_DIAGNOSTICS=true
Enable migration execution failure diagnostics.
DBEASY_MIGRATION_RETRY=true
Enable bounded safe migration retries.
DBEASY_REQUIRE_MIGRATION_IDEMPOTENCY=true
Require pending apply/rollback operations to be idempotent.
Notes:
JSON result output is non-interactive by contract.
Result stdout and diagnostic stderr formats are independent.
--verbose, --debug and --quiet cannot be used together.

commands.name: bind
commands.description:
Bind the target database to the selected DbEasy environment identity.
The verify command is strictly read-only. Binding is explicit and never overwrites a different identity.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Approve creation of the environment marker without prompting.

options.name: --output-format
options.description:
Select human text or one JSON command result on stdout.
Emit exactly one JSON result object on stdout.
JSON result mode is non-interactive by contract.
Result and log formats are independent.
Precedence: --output-format, DBEASY_OUTPUT_FORMAT, OutputFormat, text.
Notes:
--verbose, --debug and --quiet cannot be used together.

options.description:
Select a DbEasy environment profile.
Environment:
DBEASY_NON_INTERACTIVE=true
Enable non-interactive execution for automation.
DBEASY_ENVIRONMENT=Staging
DBEASY_REQUIRE_ENVIRONMENT_IDENTITY=true
Require target database identity verification for target-aware migrations.
DBEASY_LOG_FORMAT=json
Emit structured diagnostic logs as NDJSON on stderr.
DBEASY_OUTPUT_FORMAT=json
Emit one machine-readable command result on stdout.
DBEASY_MIGRATION_DIAGNOSTICS=true
Enable migration execution failure diagnostics.
DBEASY_MIGRATION_RETRY=true
Enable bounded safe migration retries.
DBEASY_MIGRATION_RETRY_MAX_COUNT=2
DBEASY_MIGRATION_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS=5000
DBEASY_MIGRATION_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS=30000
Configure retry budget/backoff.
Database environment identity:
dbeasy --environment Production environment verify
Verify __DbEasyEnvironment without modifying the target.
dbeasy --environment Production environment bind
Explicitly initialize an unbound target; never overwrites a different identity.
Logging modes:

options.name: --no-require-idempotent-migrations
options.description:
DBEASY_REQUIRE_MIGRATION_IDEMPOTENCY=true|false|1|0
Disabled by default. Dry-run still reports idempotency when disabled.
Strict mode rejects non-idempotent or unknown plans before mutation.
Safe migration retries (migration update / migration rollback):

options.name: --retry-max-delay-ms
options.description:
Disabled by default. Tuning options do not implicitly enable retries.
Retries are attempted only for provider-classified transient failures
whose migration state proves replay is safe. Commit/rollback ambiguity,
partial non-transactional DDL and changed schema/history states are never
replayed automatically.
